data_selection: All 308 rows; group by exact first five dimensionless hull columns; require 22 groups of 14 distinct Froude values; sort each group by exact Froude. No exclusions.
split: Within each hull, even zero-based sorted positions are training (7); odd positions are held-out (7). Public archival data; retrospective, not blind or independent replication.
models: Polynomial degree 1, 2, 3 separately for each hull; x=40*Froude; intercept included. Every model is reported.
fitting: Exact rational ordinary least squares; candidate producer uses Gaussian elimination. Receiver trusts no optimizer output and requires fresh Lean normal-equation/real-global-optimality proofs.
full_data_diagnostic: Also fit all 14 rows for each degree; certify global residual sum-of-squares lower bounds over all real coefficients. These diagnostics do not enter held-out training.
queries: Every held-out Froude, plus Froude=3/5 outside the observed range; compute exact dual weights and sharp L-infinity response-perturbation sensitivity.
perturbation_interpretation: Chosen adversarial response sensitivity scenarios, not measured assay precision, confidence intervals, or established coverage of physical truth. Predictor uncertainty is not modeled.
metrics: per-hull and pooled held-out SSE and maximum absolute error for all degrees
full-data globally minimal SSE by model class
exact query L1 gains and sharp adversarial attainment
optional NumPy lstsq sanity comparison; relative/absolute tolerance 1e-9
adversarial_controls: model order or held-out split substitution
evidence_policy: Freeze source hashes before the final campaign; run fresh receiving processes; retain all failures and successes without overwriting historical evidence.
